DKP suffered an $80K exploit on BNB Chain via spot price manipulation on March 8, 2023. The attacker used flash loans to distort the USDT-DKP pair's reserve ratio, enabling them to swap a small USDT amount for an outsized DKP amount and liquidate for profit. The DKP protocol's exchange function relied on the spot reserve ratio of a USDT-DKP liquidity pair as its price reference without safeguards against manipulation. A flash loan allowed the attacker to temporarily adjust the reserves and obtain DKP tokens at a falsely favorable rate.
